module_summary: AXI4 full slave bridging to a simple register-style peripheral: AW skid buffer plus write burst address generator drive o_we/o_waddr, a read burst counter and address generator drive o_rd/o_raddr, and an output skid buffer returns read data.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Write address valid into the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: Write address ready produced by the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Write burst start address entering the AW skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_awvalid
anchors.why: Skid-buffered write address valid; accepting it starts the write data phase.

anchors.name: m_awready
anchors.why: Accepts next buffered write address; loads waddr, wlen, wsize, wburst.

anchors.name: axi_awready
anchors.why: Write-phase control: high while waiting for an address, low during data burst.

anchors.name: axi_wready
anchors.why: Write data ready register, set after address accepted, cleared on WLAST; drives S_AXI_WREADY.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: AXI write data forwarded to o_wdata.

anchors.name: waddr
anchors.why: Current write beat address, loaded from AW and advanced by next_wr_addr each beat.

anchors.name: next_wr_addr
anchors.why: Next burst write address computed by axi_addr instance.

anchors.name: wlen
anchors.why: Latched write burst length used for address increment; with wsize, wburst.

anchors.name: o_we
anchors.why: Peripheral write strobe, registered from W handshake.

anchors.name: o_waddr
anchors.why: Peripheral word write address from waddr.

anchors.name: o_wdata
anchors.why: Registered write data to peripheral.

anchors.name: o_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte strobes to peripheral, zeroed when block_write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: Write response valid driven by axi_bvalid after WLAST beat.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Master accepts write response; frees double-buffered response.

anchors.name: r_bvalid
anchors.why: Second pending write response when BVALID is stalled; holds off axi_awready.

anchors.name: r_bid
anchors.why: Latched write ID for response, double-buffered into axi_bid.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BRESP
anchors.why: Write response code reporting exclusive write success.

anchors.name: axi_exclusive_write
anchors.why: Registered exclusive-okay flag driving BRESP; disabled when OPT_LOCK=0.

anchors.name: exclusive_write
anchors.why: Current write burst is a valid exclusive write; disabled when OPT_LOCK=0.

anchors.name: block_write
anchors.why: Failed exclusive write; suppresses o_wstrb. Disabled when OPT_LOCK=0.

anchors.name: write_lock_valid
anchors.why: Exclusive-access monitor result; constant zero without locking.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Read address valid; starts read burst and o_rd issue.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: Read address ready from axi_arready; selects AR vs raddr for read address.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Read burst start address loaded into raddr.

anchors.name: axi_rlen
anchors.why: Remaining read beats, loaded from ARLEN and decremented per o_rd.

anchors.name: raddr
anchors.why: Current read beat address, advanced via next_rd_addr each o_rd.

anchors.name: next_rd_addr
anchors.why: Next burst read address computed by axi_addr instance.

anchors.name: rlen
anchors.why: Latched read burst length with rsize, rburst, rid for address generation.

anchors.name: o_rd
anchors.why: Peripheral read strobe, gated by RVALID stall and skid ready; steps read counter.

anchors.name: o_raddr
anchors.why: Peripheral read address muxed from ARADDR or raddr.

anchors.name: i_rdata
anchors.why: Peripheral read data fed into read skid buffer.

anchors.name: rskd_valid
anchors.why: Read beat pending into output skid buffer, set by o_rd.

anchors.name: rskd_ready
anchors.why: Read skid buffer ready; stalls o_rd when full.

anchors.name: rskd_last
anchors.why: Last-beat flag for pending read beat, becomes RLAST.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read data valid from output skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: AXI read data from output skid buffer.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Master read ready; stalls output skid buffer and o_rd.

groups.name: AW skid buffer
groups.description: Buffers write address channel fields; m_awready pops next burst address.

groups.name: Write channel control
groups.description: Sequences address phase vs data burst via axi_awready/axi_wready; exclusive-write flags.

groups.name: Write address generator
groups.description: Holds burst parameters and advances write address each beat via axi_addr.

groups.name: Write response
groups.description: Double-buffered B channel response with ID and exclusive status.

groups.name: Peripheral port
groups.description: Simple peripheral write strobe/address/data and read strobe/address/data.

groups.name: Read burst control
groups.description: Accepts AR requests and counts remaining read beats to reassert ARREADY.

groups.name: Read address generator
groups.description: Holds read burst parameters and advances read address via axi_addr.

groups.name: Read return skid buffer
groups.description: Registers read data with ID, last and lock into R channel skid buffer.
